title: 第23章 抵抗筑基期第24章 许家宝库
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
心累！
第一次保护人，还是一个古灵精怪的大小姐，李凡确实没什么经验，不止是替大小姐干活，还常常被耍的团团转。
惹事精！
这个所谓的天才弟子，整天出幺蛾子，李凡是不胜其烦。
比如现在。
“嗯，你这个小丫头，很对本小姐……嗯，是对我的脾气，这把飞剑，半价给你！”
可是，一转身，她又是另一副面孔，嫉恶如仇的说，“你这个大胡子，一看就不是好人，这件法器是贼脏吧，五十块灵石，爱卖不卖！”
小丫头那边，自然是千恩万谢。
可是，大胡子嘛，气得胡子乱颤，眼看就要动手，还是李凡赶紧过去调解，不惜自己掏腰包，收下大胡子的这把下品法器。
度日如年！
小时候，吃不饱饭，李凡没有这种感觉。
在天贵城可怜兮兮的当一个收废品的，李凡也没有这种感觉。
可是，现在呢，整天和一些宝物打交道，自己却生出这种感觉。
这样的日子，过去五天，西凤商盟店铺里一如既往，没有出现任何麻烦。
而三小姐呢，也一直没有出现。
这天，店铺正准备打烊，却来一位俊朗潇洒的公子哥。
“咦？”
别看许喵喵这个小丫头年纪不大，却时常犯花痴。
尤其是眼前这位一位十分俊朗的公子哥，她又来了兴趣。
“欢迎光临！”

许喵喵第一个扑上前去。
李凡却微微一眯眼睛。
因为，在看到这个俊朗公子哥的一瞬间，李凡竟然感觉到自己储物袋里，有什么东西发出震动。
用神识一探查，原来是筑基期前辈府邸得到的那个玉碗。
原本平淡无奇的玉碗，此时发出一种冰寒气息。
有问题！
这段时间，玉碗一直没有表现出任何异常，以至于李凡都快忘记它的存在。
怎么俊朗公子哥的出现，却如同唤醒玉碗一般。
一向谨慎的李凡，悄悄把灵兽袋里的小黑狗，放到自己胸口的衣襟里。
同时，手中已经多出两个符咒。
中品法器寒冰剑，也随时准备攻击而出。
感觉还是不踏实，李凡小心翼翼的移动脚步，来到店铺的珍品区，将橱柜里的三张中品防御符咒，以及一面上品防御法器盾牌拿在手中。
做好一切准备，李凡释放神识，盯住这个俊朗公子哥的一举一动。
“呦，好俊俏的小生，你给我介绍介绍，你们店铺里，都有什么宝物？”
俊朗公子哥似笑非笑的问。
可惜的是，许喵喵还兴高采烈，逐一介绍起店铺的宝物，“我们西凤商盟，各种宝物应有尽有，中品法器，中级符咒，阵法等等！”
content_en:
Tired!
The first time he protected someone was an eccentric young lady. Li Fan really had no experience. Not only did he work for the young lady, he was also often fooled around.
Troublemaker!
This so-called genius disciple makes mistakes all day long, and Li Fan is very annoyed.
Such as now.
"Well, you little girl, you are very angry with me... well, you are angry with me. I will give you half the price of this flying sword!"
However, when she turned around, she showed another face, saying with hatred and hatred, "You bearded man, you are not a good person at first glance. This magic weapon is dirty, right? Fifty spiritual stones, sell it if you like!"
The little girl is naturally very grateful.
However, the bearded man was so angry that his beard was trembling, and he was about to take action. Li Fan hurried over to mediate, and he did not hesitate to pay for the low-grade magic weapon from the bearded man.
Every day feels like a year!
When he was a child, Li Fan didn't feel like he didn't have enough to eat.
Li Fan didn't feel this way about being a pitiful waste collector in Tiangui City.
But now, dealing with some treasures all day long, I feel this way.
On days like this, in the past five days, the Xifeng Merchant Alliance store has been as usual without any trouble.
As for the third lady, she never showed up.
On this day, the store was about to close, but a handsome and handsome young man came.
"Huh?"
Although Xu Miaomiao is a young girl, she is often a nymphomaniac.
Especially the very handsome young man in front of her, she became interested again.
"Welcome!"
Xu Miaomiao was the first to pounce forward.
Li Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.
Because, the moment he saw this handsome young man, Li Fan felt something vibrating in his storage bag.
After using my spiritual sense to investigate, I found out that it was the jade bowl obtained from the residence of the senior in the Foundation Establishment period.
The originally plain jade bowl now gave off an icy aura.
There's a problem!
During this period of time, the Jade Bowl had not shown any abnormalities, so much so that Li Fan had almost forgotten its existence.
How come the appearance of the handsome young master is like awakening the jade bowl.
Li Fan, who was always cautious, quietly put the little black dog in the spirit animal bag into the lapel of his chest.
At the same time, there were two more talismans in his hand.
The middle-grade magic weapon Ice Sword is also ready to attack at any time.
Still feeling unsteady, Li Fan moved cautiously to the treasure area of ​​the store and took the three middle-grade defensive spells and a high-grade defensive magic weapon shield in his hands.
After being prepared for everything, Li Fan released his spiritual consciousness and watched every move of this handsome young man.
"Hey, what a handsome young man, please introduce me to me. What treasures do you have in your shop?"
The handsome young man asked with a half-smile.
It's a pity that Xu Miaomiao was still excited and introduced the treasures in the store one by one, "We in the Xifeng Merchant Alliance have all kinds of treasures, including mid-level magic weapons, mid-level spells, formations, etc.!"
